subject: ClearPay kickoff: implementation context charter & token estimates
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearpay.ai>, Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@clearpay.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: ClearPay kickoff: implementation context charter & token estimates

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. I wanted to kick off the implementation thread so our CS + implementation team can line up the model shortlist and a first-pass token/throughput estimate before the formal kickoff. Attached: clearpay_requirements.xlsx (customer flows + example prompts) and sample_token_profile.csv (format we use to run projections).

High-level ask from our side: could you confirm the following so we can finalize a model shortlist and sizing?
- Expected average context length (tokens) for primary flows (chat, dispute summarization, doc extract)
- Percent of requests that will exceed 2048 tokens (long-context flows)
- Expected steady-state and peak requests-per-second (or monthly peak tokens if easier)
- Any strict PII/retention constraints (e.g., must keep PII in your environment / no retention)

Preliminary model candidates (we'll finalize after your answers):
- Redwood-7B-Quant (cost-efficient candidate for chat)
- LlamaX-13B (latency/capacity tradeoff for richer summaries)
- MPT-30B-Long (for doc parsing / >2048 token flows)

Proposed next steps: once we get the numbers above we will: (1) produce a token/day estimate and costing delta across the shortlist, (2) propose a small A/B rollout (canary traffic split), and (3) schedule a kickoff week of Nov 10 if that works for you.

If you prefer a short call instead of answering in-line, I can send a 20-min slot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into implementation.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[aisha_rahman@redwood.ai]
Redwood Inference
Attachments: clearpay_requirements.xlsx (stated examples), sample_token_profile.csv (CSV schema)
From: Elena Morales <elena@clearpay.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@clearpay.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: ClearPay kickoff: implementation context charter & token estimates

Hi Aisha —

Thanks — see answers inline and attached a completed requirements sheet (clearpay_requirements.xlsx).

- Average context length: ~512 tokens for chat flows; summaries average ~1,200 tokens; document parsing flows can be 3k–6k tokens (we usually chunk).
- Percent >2048: ~18–22% (mostly doc parsing and certain dispute cases).
- Traffic: steady-state ~6–8 requests/sec; anticipated marketing/rainy-day peaks up to 30–40 req/sec for short windows. Monthly active tokens estimate: ~1.2M tokens/day average, with peaks closer to 3.5M tokens/day for promo months.
- PII/retention: we need PII tokens (names, emails, SSNs) to be scrubbed before storage in Redwood-hosted logs; for Private/Dedicated options, ClearPay requires retention=0 for raw PII and customer-managed KMS for keys. We'll detail in the attached sheet under the Compliance tab.

Preferred kickoff: Nov 10–12 window; Nov 10 morning PST is ideal.

Attached: clearpay_requirements.xlsx (complete), a couple of sample prompts in the sheet. Let me know if you need the raw prompt corpus as a separate file.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of ML Ops | ClearPay
elena@clearpay.ai

Subject: Re: ClearPay kickoff: implementation context charter & token estimates

Elena — great, thanks for the detail and the completed sheet. Confirming we received the prompt examples — please attach the raw corpus if you have it, it helps Ben's throughput sims.

Based on your numbers I've put together a short model + sizing recommendation (summary below) — we'll generate a full token/day and cost delta spreadsheet (separate).

Our recommended shortlist (initial):
- Redwood-7B-Quant: primary chat candidate for cost efficiency and low-latency responses (good for 70–80% of your chat traffic).
- LlamaX-13B: higher-quality summarization/few-shot inference for dispute cases and richer summaries.
- MPT-30B-Long: dedicated long-context workers for document parsing (3k–6k tokens).

First-pass capacity estimate (rough):
- Avg tokens/day (baseline): 1.2M tokens/day (customer-provided)
- Peak tokens/day (promo month): ~3.5M tokens/day
- Estimated split: 72% chat (avg ctx 512), 18% summaries (avg 1.2k), 10% doc-parsing (avg 4k)
- Using typical generation lengths we estimate ~3.1M tokens/day in mixed workload during peak and ~1.3M on steady-state months.

Operational notes / asks for Redwood internal owners:
- Ben: can you run latency & throughput sims for the three candidates using the sample corpus (drive link in related_links) and produce an initial autoscale policy (target 95%ile latency, warm KV cache assumptions)?
- Grace: please draft a rollout plan (canary -> staged) and ownership matrix; include rollback criteria and model fallback policies.

Elena / Marcus: if that aligns with you, we'll finalize the cost delta spreadsheet and mark Nov 10 at 10:00 AM PST for kickoff (calendar link in related_links). Also attaching the Redwood handoff checklist for your internal review.

Thanks — assigning the action items below and copying internal owners.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_handoff_checklist.pdf
